# Retrains of released methods (AD5): environment for SelfMAD. Pins from SelfMAD conda/env.yml (commit 09ed0819) for
# torch, torchvision, opencv, albumentations, albucore, tqdm, efficientnet-pytorch, timm. Not pinned by the authors

# on the DGX, not here), transformers (preprocessing/faceparser.py). Our choices below are versions current at the
